channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Shell takes stake in Equinor's Canadian oil project
item.description: Shell has agreed to acquire a 30% stake in Equinor's Bay du Nord oil project located in Canada. The project is situated off the coast of Newfoundland and Labrador. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Alaska Fish Fight Over Trawling Fuels Consumer Concern
item.description: A dispute over trawling practices in Alaska is drawing attention to the origin of fish used in American fish sticks. The conflict centers on how fish are caught and processed, impacting the supply chain for consumer products. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Businesses protest government surcharge ban
item.description: Businesses in Sydney are protesting a government ban on surcharges, with some stating that 'cash is king'. The ban, which has drawn criticism from businesses, is the subject of ongoing debate. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Walmart Canada Offers Deals on Various Products
item.description: Walmart Canada is holding a "Deal Days" event, offering discounts on a range of products. News outlets are highlighting specific deals available during this promotion. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Savings rates rise, but experts warn they may not last
item.description: Interest rates on savings accounts have seen an increase, with some National Savings & Investments (NS&I) accounts now offering over 5% for the first time in nearly three years. Experts suggest that these high rates may not persist due to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: GSK to invest $800 million in Pennsylvania biopharma hub
item.description: GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) plans to invest over $800 million to expand its biopharmaceutical hub in Pennsylvania, a move expected to create 300 jobs. The company's investment will focus on enhancing its biopharma capabilities within the state. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Oil Prices Surge Above $104 Amid Hormuz Attacks and Hurricane Fears
item.description: Global oil prices have surpassed $104 per barrel, driven by concerns over supply disruptions. Attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz have reached a "wartime high," with Iran reportedly attempting to restrict oil exports. Concurrently… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Jio Platforms and Airtel Money Pursue Major Listings
item.description: Jio Platforms is reportedly being considered for an Initial Public Offering (IPO) at a valuation of approximately ₹11 lakh crore, which would place it slightly above Airtel's current market capitalization of around ₹10.87 lakh crore… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh and MP Announce Investment Drives for Job Creation
item.description: Andhra Pradesh's Minister Bharath announced an investment drive targeting the Orvakal industrial hub, aiming to attract ₹50,000 crore and create 45,000 jobs. Separately, Madhya Pradesh has reportedly drawn ₹90,000 crore in investment… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sees 6.3 Million Concurrent Users
item.description: Flipkart's Big Billion Days sale event commenced with 6.3 million concurrent users accessing the platform. The figure represents the number of users simultaneously present on Flipkart during the sale's opening. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India's Diesel Exports Reach 12-Month High in September
item.description: India's diesel exports reached a 12-month high in September, driven by a global refining shock and a surge in shipments to Europe. This increase marks a significant rise in the country's diesel export volume over the past year. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: iQIYI Holiday Snapshot Shows Increased Viewing Time, Big Screen Dominance
item.description: A snapshot of iQIYI's 2026 National Day Holiday viewing habits indicates a rise in daily viewing time by over 12%, driven by premium titles. Big screens accounted for nearly 60% of this viewing time. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Online Calculators Help Plan Loan Repayments
item.description: Online EMI calculators are available for various loan types, including car loans and personal loans, to help individuals plan their repayment schedules. These tools allow users to calculate their Equated Monthly Installments (EMIs) online… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: US Green Card Program Suspends Applications for IT Firms
item.description: The United States has suspended applications for the Green Card program for several major IT companies, including Microsoft, Infosys, TCS, and Wipro. This action, announced by Senator JD Vance, affects the ability of high-skilled workers… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel to enter US and global markets
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump announced a deal following talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin for Russia to supply nearly 5 million tons of diesel fuel to the United States and global markets. The agreement aims to lower fuel prices… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 13 · Right 4.

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices Rise on October 9
item.description: On October 9, the prices of gold and silver saw an increase. The latest rates for gold were reported in Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Jio Plans Space-Based Internet, Aims for 6G Rollout
item.description: Reliance Jio is planning to expand its network into space with a proposed constellation of approximately 1,600 low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites. The company is also reportedly positioning India to be among the first countries to roll out… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Jeff Bezos predicts AI-driven 3-day workweek
item.description: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos has stated that artificial intelligence could enable a three-day workweek and assist single-income families. He believes AI's advancements will lead to these changes. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Foreign currency deposits may impact bank margins
item.description: Inflows from Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) or FCNR(B) deposits are anticipated to put pressure on the profit margins of banks. Additionally, capital goods companies are facing challenges due to a slowdown in order inflows during the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: TCS Reports Slowest Q2 Growth in Three Years Amidst Muted Demand
item.description: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) reported its slowest second-quarter revenue growth in three years, with a 0.2% sequential increase in the July-September period. This growth, however, exceeded analyst expectations. The company noted… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: JSW to Launch First Combat SUV on December 4
item.description: JSW is set to launch its first combat SUV on December 4. The vehicle is reported to have a range of 1100 km on a full tank and will feature a powerful look. It is also stated that the SUV can run 90 km without petrol. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: China's Golden Week Sees Tourism Boom but Lower Per-Trip Spending
item.description: Despite a tourism boom during China's National Day 'golden week' holiday, hotel room rates across mainland China and average spending per domestic trip fell short of expectations. Hotel tariffs remained largely unchanged, and average… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Analysis of Silver's Long-Term Growth Potential for Gen Z
item.description: This analysis explores the long-term growth potential of silver as an investment, specifically targeting Generation Z. It posits that silver could be considered the 'new gold' and highlights the importance of correctly pricing water… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Treasury Secretary Bessent Skips IMF-World Bank Meetings
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent will not attend the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank meetings scheduled to take place in Bangkok. The reason for his absence was not specified in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: SpaceX Seeks $40 Billion Financing for Nvidia Chip Purchases
item.description: SpaceX is reportedly in discussions to secure $40 billion in financing, primarily to purchase Nvidia chips. The financing is being led by Apollo, according to reports. This move is part of a broader trend where technology companies and AI… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 10 · Right 0.

item.title: UPI Merchant Discount Rate Rollout Postponed to January 2027
item.description: The implementation of the merchant discount rate (MDR) on Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions has been postponed to January 2027. This decision comes after trade associations requested a deferral, citing concerns about the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Global Bond Yields See Rise, Impacting Borrowers and Investors
item.description: Bond yields are experiencing a global increase, affecting both those who borrow money and those who invest. The reasons behind this rise and its specific implications for borrowers and investors are being examined. The situation has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 12 · Right 0.

item.title: EU and China agree to limit hybrid car exports
item.description: The European Union and China have reached an understanding to reduce China's hybrid car exports to the EU. Brussels stated that Beijing's shipments could fall by more than half over four years, potentially cutting millions of vehicles… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump envoy's financial ties to oil pipeline firm revealed
item.description: A former U.S. envoy under the Trump administration maintained financial ties to a company planning a $15 billion oil pipeline designed to bypass the Strait of Hormuz. The envoy reportedly pushed for the Iraq-Syria oil pipeline project on… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Lifts Sanctions on Russian Diesel Sales
item.description: The United States has lifted sanctions on the sale of Russian diesel in global markets, a move that will be effective until April 2027. The decision was announced on Friday. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Reports Five-Fold Profit Surge in Q2
item.description: Poonawalla Fincorp announced a net profit of ₹375 crore for the second quarter, a five-fold increase year-on-year. The company's net interest income rose by 75.6% due to loan portfolio expansion. New disbursements accounted for 28% of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: India aims for $1 trillion exports by FY27
item.description: Union Minister Piyush Goyal has expressed confidence that India will achieve its target of $1 trillion in exports by the fiscal year 2027. The strategy to reach this goal reportedly involves leveraging Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Government Caps Cancer Drug Margins, Prices May Fall Up To 70%
item.description: The Indian government has capped trade margins on non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs at 30%, a move expected to reduce prices by up to 70% and save patients an estimated ₹2,500 crore annually. Some reports indicate that in certain cases… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: UN Trade Body Predicts Slowing Global Economic Growth
item.description: The United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) projects that global economic growth will decelerate to 2.6 percent in 2026. This forecast indicates a slowdown in the world economy for the coming years. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US Treasury yields ease after strong bond auction demand
item.description: US Treasury yields retreated from recent highs following a strong auction of 30-year bonds, which drew unexpectedly firm demand. The selloff in US bonds also eased, with yields moving off their peaks after the solid auction of 10-year… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Starbucks Reportedly Explored Acquiring Chipotle
item.description: Starbucks has reportedly explored the possibility of acquiring the restaurant chain Chipotle. This exploration was revealed in reports, leading to a jump in Chipotle's stock. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Delta Air Lines Reduces Earnings Forecast Amid Rising Costs
item.description: Delta Air Lines has lowered its earnings forecast for 2026, projecting adjusted earnings between $5.10 and $5.60 per share, a significant decrease from its previous projection of $6.50 to $7.50 per share. This adjustment comes as the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Public Sector Banks Show Strong Business Growth in Q2
item.description: Five public sector banks reported credit growth between 15% and 25% in the second quarter of the financial year 2027. This growth was driven by sustained demand for credit across agriculture, industry, services, and personal loans… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Netflix Reportedly Planning Significant Workforce Reductions
item.description: Netflix is reportedly planning to lay off approximately 5% of its workforce, with some reports indicating the cuts could occur as early as next week. The streaming giant is pursuing new revenue streams, including expansion into live… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: SpaceX seeks low-band spectrum for US mobile service
item.description: SpaceX is seeking to acquire low-band spectrum for mobile phone service in the US, which would enable its Starlink satellite service to operate as a major mobile carrier. The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is set to vote on… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 8 · Right 0.
